title: Diff handoff, provenance log, human approval
description:
**Phase 5 of MVP** under `PPY-54055d`.

## Intent

As a publication operator, I want a diff, provenance, and a human approval gate, so externally attributable copy is never auto-published and quality outcomes can be tracked over time.

## Done when

- Operator sees a **diff** (original vs proposed), not an auto-published rewrite.
- Provenance retained: original draft, each revision, model/version, retrieved sources, change log, human approve/reject.
- External publish requires human approval.
- Quality metrics logged over time: accepted revisions, deletions, unsupported-claim rate, reader edits, post-publication corrections.

## Depends on

Verifier + acceptance gate.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Diff handoff, provenance, and human approval
  As a publication operator
  I want a reviewable diff and a provenance log
  So I can approve or reject a revision and never auto-publish external copy

  Scenario: Present a diff instead of publishing
    Given a proposed revision that passed or failed the acceptance gate
    When the operator opens the handoff
    Then they see a diff of original versus proposed copy
    And the revision is not published to an external surface

  Scenario: Record provenance and the human decision
    Given a proposed revision with model version, retrieved sources, and change log
    When a human approves or rejects it
    Then provenance retains the original draft, each revision, model version, retrieved sources, change log, and the human decision
    And quality metrics can record accepted revisions, deletions, and unsupported-claim rate
```
